substantive_difference: Old unit20 saved no PNG or calls, rejecting unsupported new equalities. This design uses only true equal rotation radii and targets the intermediate-versus-requested angle frame, with no new equality/angle relation.
new_mechanism: Bind the two actual equal rotation-radius sides ST and TV as a blue pair and the existing dotted SV as the base. The hypothesized error is returning the isosceles base angle TSV=25 instead of subtracting it from RST=60 to obtain requested RSV=35.
